claims.claim: Prompt caching offers two TTL values: 5 minutes (default) and 1 hour (extended)
claims.citation: Prompt caching w Claude API oferuje dwie wartosci TTL: **5 minut (default)** i **1 godzina (extended)**. Wybierasz przez pole `ttl` w `cache_control`: `"ephemeral"` (domyslnie 5m) lub `"ephemeral" + "ttl": "1h"`.

claims.claim: TTL resets on each cache hit with no additional cost, allowing active sessions to maintain 5m cache for hours if requests arrive within 5-minute intervals
claims.citation: TTL resetuje sie przy kazdym cache hit bez dodatkowego kosztu - aktywna sesja moze utrzymac 5m cache przez godziny o ile kolejne requesty ida co <5 min.

claims.claim: Two undisclosed TTL regressions occurred in 2026 (March 6 and April 9) causing users' bills to increase 17-53% due to fallback to 5m instead of 1h
claims.citation: dwie wykryte, nieoglaszane regressions TTL (March 6 i April 9), w wyniku ktorych tysiacom uzytkownikow wzrosly rachunki o 17-53% przez powrot do 5m zamiast 1h.

claims.claim: 5-minute TTL write cost is 1.25x base input, while 1-hour TTL write cost is 2.0x base input for Claude Sonnet 4.6
claims.citation: | 5m cache write | $3.75 | 1.25x | | 1h cache write | $6.00 | 2.0x |

claims.claim: Cache write break-even point: 5m TTL breaks even after 1 cache read; 1h TTL breaks even after 2 cache reads
claims.citation: Break-even: 5m TTL po 1 odczycie; 1h TTL po 2 odczytach.
claims.source_location: Details, section 1: TTL reset on use

claims.claim: Cache invalidation is hierarchical: changes to tools invalidate tool/system/messages caches; system changes invalidate system/messages caches
claims.citation: Inwalidacja cache jest hierarchiczna: tools -> system -> messages. Kazdazmiana na danym poziomie kasuje ten poziom i wszystkie ponizej.

claims.claim: Adding a single message at the end of a conversation does not invalidate the prefix when prefix matching is used correctly
claims.citation: Dodanie jednej wiadomosci na koncu konwersacji NIE invaliduje prefiksu (prefix matching backward).

claims.claim: Adding a single tool mid-session invalidates the entire cache
claims.citation: Dodanie jednego narzedzia MID-session kasuje CALY cache.

claims.claim: Prefix caching writes cache entries only at explicit breakpoints, not at earlier positions
claims.citation: Marking a block with `cache_control` writes exactly one cache entry: a hash of the prefix ending at that block. The system does not write entries for any earlier position.

claims.claim: Prefix caching lookback window is limited to 20 blocks per breakpoint; if no match is found within 20 blocks, lookback stops
claims.citation: The system checks at most 20 positions per breakpoint, counting the breakpoint itself as the first. If the system finds no matching entry in that window, checking stops.

claims.claim: March 6, 2026 TTL regression affected 119,866 API calls across two machines and accounts, causing $949.08 overpayment (17.1% cost increase) for Sonnet 4.6
claims.citation: Actual cost: $5,561.17; Expected (1h TTL): $4,612.09; **Nadplatka: $949.08 (17.1% strata)**; Marzec osobno: 25.9% overpayment, $719.09 wasted
claims.source_location: Details, section 6: March 6 first silent TTL regression

claims.claim: The March 2026 TTL regression was selective: main agents remained unaffected while sub-agents were downgraded to 5m TTL
claims.citation: main agent mial zero 5m writes przez caly okres analizy; KAZDA akcja TTL Anthropica dotyczyła wylacznie **sub-agentow**. To wskazuje ze downgrade byl serwerowy i selektywny, nie globalny.
claims.source_location: Details, section 6: March 6 first silent TTL regression

claims.claim: Anthropic did not publicly confirm the TTL regressions; GitHub Issue #46829 was closed as 'not planned' without official explanation
claims.citation: Status Issue #46829: Zamkniety jako "not planned" bez oficjalnego komentarza Anthropica.
claims.source_location: Details, section 6: March 6 first silent TTL regression

claims.claim: April 9, 2026 second regression affected sub-agents exclusively (100% 5m TTL for 5 days) while main agents remained on 1h TTL
claims.citation: Poczawszy od 9 kwietnia 2026, sub-agenty przeszly na **100% 5m TTL** przez 5 kolejnych dni (4,840 API calls zero 1h writes)... Kwiecien: TYLKO sub-agents (main agent pozostal na 100% 1h)
claims.source_location: Details, section 7: April 9 second silent TTL regression

claims.claim: Claude Code v2.1.108 (April 14, 2026) introduces ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H env var to force 1h TTL across Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex, and Azure Foundry
claims.citation: | `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1` | Wymusza 1h TTL na Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex, Azure Foundry | **AKTYWNY** (od v2.1.108) |

claims.claim: AWS Bedrock supports 1h TTL for Claude Opus 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Sonnet 4.5, but older model series (3.7, 3.5 variants, 4.0, 4.1) only support 5m TTL
claims.citation: Claude Opus 4.5: TAK (1h); Claude Haiku 4.5: TAK (1h); Claude Sonnet 4.5: TAK (1h); Claude Opus 4.1, Opus 4, Sonnet 4, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, 3.5 Haiku, 3.5 Sonnet v2: **NIE (tylko 5m)**
claims.source_location: Details, section 9: Bedrock model support for 1h TTL

claims.claim: Google Vertex AI applies same prefix matching and invalidation rules as Anthropic native API but uses project-level isolation instead of workspace-level
claims.citation: Vertex zachowuje sie "as described in Anthropic documentation" dla prompt caching - te same zasady prefix matching, lookback 20 blokow, te same triggery invalidacji.

claims.claim: Anthropic switched to workspace-level cache isolation starting February 5, 2026, replacing organization-level isolation
claims.citation: Starting February 5, 2026, prompt caching will use workspace-level isolation instead of organization-level isolation.

claims.claim: 1-hour cache entries must appear before 5-minute entries in mixed-TTL requests; 1h/5m mismatch in automatic cache control causes 400 error
claims.citation: **1-hour cache entries MUSZA pojawiac sie PRZED 5-minute entries**... Konflikt TTL w automatycznym cache: jezeli ostatni blok ma explicite `cache_control` z innym TTL niz top-level automatic cache control -> API zwraca **400 error**.

claims.claim: DISABLE_TELEMETRY flag caused fallback to 5m TTL in versions prior to v2.1.108 (Issue #45381)
claims.citation: Fixed subscribers who set DISABLE_TELEMETRY falling back to 5-minute prompt cache TTL instead of 1 hour

claims.claim: Adding an image to a message mid-session invalidates both tools and system caches, preserving only messages cache
claims.citation: Jezeli nowa wiadomosc zawiera image -> tools + system cache INVALIDATED
claims.source_location: Details, section 4: Edge case - adding 1 message

claims.claim: Changing tool_choice mid-session invalidates all three cache levels (tools, system, messages)
claims.citation: Jezeli nowa wiadomosc zmienia tool_choice -> tools + system cache INVALIDATED
claims.source_location: Details, section 4: Edge case - adding 1 message

claims.claim: Cache invalidation does not occur when increasing max_tokens, changing temperature, top_p, or top_k
claims.citation: Co NIE invaliduje cache (przy poprawnym prefix matching): Zwiekszenienie `max_tokens`; Zmiana `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`

claims.claim: Web search toggle, citations toggle, and speed settings are cached at tools level; changes invalidate tools cache but not system/messages
claims.citation: | **Web search toggle** | INVALIDATED | OK | OK | | **Citations toggle** | INVALIDATED | OK | OK | | **Speed setting** (fast mode) | INVALIDATED | OK | OK |

claims.claim: Thinking parameters (enable/disable/budget) affect tools and system caches but not messages cache when changed
claims.citation: | **Thinking parameters** (enable/disable/budget) | INVALIDATED | INVALIDATED | OK |

claims.claim: Anthropic stated 'cache TTL change should not increase costs' but empirical data shows 17.1-25.9% cost increases contradicting this claim
claims.citation: Anthropic oficjalnie (The Register) twierdzi ze "cache TTL change should not increase costs." Empiryczne dane z Issue #46829 (119,866 calls) pokazuja 17.1-25.9% nadplatke.

claims.claim: Official Anthropic documentation does not define what constitutes a 'cache hit' for TTL reset purposes (per-call vs per-entry access unclear)
claims.citation: Brak oficjalnej definicji co Anthropic rozumie przez "cache hit" dla celow TTL reset. Czy reset nastepuje przy kazdym API call ktory uzyza cache, czy przy kazdym cache entry access wewnatrz jednego call?

claims.claim: AWS Bedrock supports automatic caching but feature is 'COMING LATER' without defined ETA
claims.citation: | Automatic caching | TAK | COMING LATER |

claims.claim: Bedrock Sonnet 4.6 model series 1h TTL support status remains unconfirmed in official documentation
claims.citation: Modele serii 4.6 (Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6): status niepotwierdzony w docs

claims.claim: April 9, 2026 TTL regression lacks official Anthropic confirmation; only reported by community auditor recca0120 without independent verification
claims.citation: Brak publicznej informacji o tej regression w momencie pisania raportu (2026-04-17).
